work.delete.title: delete this session
work.delete.means: Deletes this conversation’s record and what this machine kept of it: its words, its transcript and its files. Nothing brings it back.
work.delete.done: Deleted {{id}}: its record, and its words, transcript and files on this machine, are gone.
work.stop.title: stop this session
work.stop.drivenHeld: Stops the session now. Its quest stays taken here, its tree keeps what it wrote, and the driver will not carry it on until you choose Try again.
work.stop.drivenOpen: Stops the session now. The driver will not start #{{quest}} again on this machine until you choose Try again; another machine may still take it.
work.stop.parked: Stops it unanswered. Its quest stays taken here until you choose Try again.
work.stop.chat: Ends this conversation; it takes no more messages. Finish lets its agent wind up instead.
work.archive.none: Nothing that ended is left to archive.
work.archive.keptYou: Kept in the list: {{count}} waiting on you.
work.archive.keptReview: Kept in the list: {{count}} to review.
work.archive.keptBoth: Kept in the list: {{you}} waiting on you, {{review}} to review.
work.archive.done: Archived. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings it back.
work.archive.ended: Archived {{count}} session that ended. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings it back.
work.archive.ended_other: Archived {{count}} sessions that ended. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings them back.
work.archive.endedKept: Archived {{archived}} of {{count}}; the rest changed since the list. Show archived, in the list’s ⋯, brings them back.
work.archive.back: Unarchived. It is back in the list.
work.archive.wasNot: It was not archived, so nothing changed.
work.timeline.title: Timeline
work.timeline.hint: what was observed — process lifetime, the quest's transitions, and what landed in git. Never a reading of the stream.
work.attended.none.headline: Nothing attended
work.attended.none.body: Choose a session in the session list and it opens here — its record, what was observed, and its console while it runs.
work.context.label: context
work.context.measured: Context: {{used}} of {{size}} tokens ({{percent}}), as the agent last reported it. The most this session has held is {{most}}.
work.context.pending: Not measured yet: this agent has not reported its context. It does as a turn runs or when one ends, and a stopped turn may report none.
work.context.text: Not measured: this agent’s door carries only text, so it reports no context.
work.context.unknown: Not measured: nothing has reported this session’s context.
work.meter.tookFirst: Took {{took}} by this machine’s clock; the first answer came after {{first}}.
work.meter.tokens: As the agent reported it: {{input}} tokens in ({{fresh}} new, {{written}} written to its cache), {{read}} read from its cache, and {{output}} out.
work.find.label: Find in this session
work.intake.title: Intake for ask #{{ask}}
work.intake.hint: The declarations did not settle whose this is, so the intake asked rather than guess. The answer is on the ask: publish it to a repository, or close it, and this session ends at the driver's next look.
work.intake.stopMeans: Stopping ends the intake without answering: the ask stays a proposal for you to publish or close.
work.intakeRunning.title: This intake is reading ask #{{ask}}
work.intakeRunning.hint: It takes no messages: an intake is one turn. If the declarations do not settle whose this is, it asks you by parking, and the answer is on the ask.
work.frame.none: No session is attended. Choose one in Sessions, and its timeline and its review follow it here.
work.frame.ended: The session attended in Sessions has ended, so nothing follows it here. A session's timeline and its review follow it here while it runs or waits on you.
work.monitor.title: Monitor window
work.monitor.subtitle: Everything running, live. Read-only — the moves stay in the main window.
work.monitor.elsewhere: Runs on {{origin}}. Its console stays on that machine; what travelled here is the record.
work.monitor.empty.headline: Nothing is running
work.monitor.empty.body: This window fills as the driver takes quests and as you open conversations in the main window.
work.monitor.driverStopped: The driver on this machine is not running, so nothing will start here.
work.detached.gone.headline: No record of that session
work.detached.gone.body: It is not in this workspace's ledger — it may have been in another workspace, or this window outlived it.
work.options.group: this conversation's model and effort, as its agent offers them
work.options.label: this conversation's {{name}}
work.steer.placeholder: tell it something while it works — the conversation shows when it reads it. Enter queues, Shift+Enter makes a newline.
work.steer.nowTip: stop the turn it is on so what you added goes now — the session keeps going, and keeps what it has done.
work.steer.sending: Stopping its turn: what you added goes next.
work.say.placeholder: write to it — the same session goes on with your words
work.say.heldEnding: held until this run ends — then the same session goes on with them
work.say.tooLong: This agent's door takes at most {{count}} characters at once; shorten it, or send it in parts.
work.say.cannot: It cannot go on in this session, because {{why}}.
work.say.startChat: Start a conversation with these words
work.say.goOnNew: Go on in a new session
work.say.newSession.loses: A new session can take your words now, without this conversation's context.
work.say.newSession.sent: A new session takes your words at the driver's next look, without this conversation's context.
work.say.newSession.running: It is still running, so your words reach it there; it needs no new session.
work.say.newSession.noWords: No words of yours wait on it to go on with.
work.say.newSession.conversation: A conversation does not go on in a new session by itself; start a conversation with these words instead.
work.say.newSession.closed: #{{quest}} has closed, so nothing carries its words on by itself; start a conversation with them instead.
work.say.newSession.notCooling: Its account is not cooling any more, so the same session goes on with your words at the driver's next look.
work.say.teammate: This session ran on another machine, where its conversation is.
work.say.stoodDown: It stood down: #{{quest}} is someone else's, so it has nothing to go on with.
work.say.intake: An intake takes no words: it is answered through its ask.
work.say.help: Ask Daoris's conversations take words in its own panel, which starts a new one.
work.say.superseded: #{{quest}} went on in a later session here, so write to that one.
work.say.notFound: Daoris no longer has this session's record, so nothing can take words for it.
work.say.notTaken: Nothing took these words just now, so they are back in the box.
work.say.why.account: its conversation stays with the account it ran on, and this start runs on another
work.say.why.adapter: it ran on {{from}}, and starts here now run on {{to}}
work.say.why.unkept: Daoris kept no id for its conversation
work.say.why.offered: the agent offers no way to continue a conversation
work.say.why.gone: the agent no longer has its conversation
work.say.why.refused: its conversation could not be continued
work.say.why.elsewhere: its conversation is open in another client of {{agent}}
work.say.why.teammate: it ran on another machine, where its conversation is
work.say.why.intake: an intake is answered through its ask
work.say.why.stoodDown: it stood down, so it has nothing to go on with
work.say.why.started: you started a conversation with them
work.say.startFrom.running: It still runs, so your words reach it there; it needs no new conversation.
work.say.startFrom.noWords: No words wait on this session now, so there is nothing to start a conversation with.
work.say.startFrom.carried: Its quest is still open, so the driver carries these words on with it by itself.
work.dock.label: right side bar
work.dock.cramped: This side bar is too narrow to sit beside the session — close it, or widen the window.
work.views.right: views in the right side bar
work.views.toRight: Move {{view}} to the right side bar
work.views.empty: Nothing is here now. Move a view here from its tab's menu, or reset the view locations.
